prompt:
Create ONE large boss monster sprite for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG battle (a single figure).

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: the light-grey box shows where the boss stands and how big it is (fill the box), the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the boss faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, crisp cel shading and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero.

Image 3 is the APPROVED LOOK of this exact boss in its idle pose (pixel art). Keep the identical design, armour, colours, proportions and size; only the pose changes.

Render as true pixel art: the boss about 140-168 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, rich detail and 3-4 tones per colour like a premium modern pixel-art boss.

Boss: the Hollow Seraph, exactly as in Image 3: a hovering hollow suit of elegant white and pale-gold armour with no body inside, the open helm showing only darkness, the fractured golden halo floating above the helm, exactly six articulated mechanical wings, three on each side, of overlapping metallic feathers in white steel with brass joints, thin hanging greaves; palette of white steel, pale gold, brass, storm grey and a cold white-blue glow. FACE: no face; the empty dark helm opening and the halo are the readable features.

Pose: a sharp jolt: bright cracks across the breastplate, the two broken halo arcs knocked askew above the helm, the whole armour tilted back by about fifteen degrees, the helm with its visor bars around the dark opening exactly as in Image 3; the three wings on the left side of the image and the three wings on the right side of the image all stay visible, the lowest wing on each side faltering downward with its feathers splayed, the upper wings flaring; the posture stays upright and controlled, her composure intact; no cape, cloth or ribbon anywhere (Image 3 has none), recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right, facing right.

MOVEMENT: this is a dramatic ACTION frame of a huge, intimidating boss, not a static stance. Keep the front or three-quarter front view of Image 3 and a symmetric, composed posture, the armour upright or tilted only slightly; all six wings stay separately visible with their brass joints, three on the left side of the image and three on the right side of the image, none hidden behind the armour or bunched together; the movement is in the wings, gauntlets and halo, and trailing parts lag behind the motion. The silhouette must be very different from the idle reference. Any part of the body or weapon may reach beyond the sides of the grey box. BODY: hovering above the ground, nothing touches the ground, no shadow, no water. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

Only the boss: no other characters, no scenery, no floor tiles, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no shadows, no borders, no panels.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a face, a body or skin inside the armour, feathered bird wings, more or fewer than six wings, a sword.
